overview: Kuala Lumpur's towers and malls, Legoland in Johor, and the beaches and cable car of Langkawi. Good value, friendly and easy with Indian food widely available.
fit: Very good for both kids, especially Legoland and Langkawi's calm beaches.
season: Hot and humid all year. West coast (KL, Langkawi) is driest December–April; October–November is wettest. East coast monsoon is November–February.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Kuala Lumpur direct (AirAsia, Malaysia Airlines, IndiGo)

gettingAround: KL has a good rail network; Grab cabs everywhere.

todo.title: Petronas Towers skybridge and KLCC park

todo.title: Legoland Malaysia (Johor)
todo.book: Fly or train to Johor Bahru

foodTips: Indian vegetarian food is easy to find, especially in Brickfields.
save: Use Grab instead of street taxis
Combine with Singapore by bus or train via Johor
safety: Generally safe; watch for bag snatching in busy KL areas
kids: Do KLCC park water play in the late afternoon

days.plan: Legoland day trip (or another beach day)

visa: Indian citizens can visit visa-free for up to 30 days (extended through 2026). Fill in the Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC) online within 3 days before arrival. Check the latest rules before booking.
